title: useRef for things that aren't state
why_it_matters: It lets you touch the DOM or keep a value without re-rendering.
explanation: A ref holds a value in .current. Changing it does not cause a re-render. Attach one to an element to focus it, scroll it or measure it. It is an escape hatch, so reach for state first.
try_it: Auto-focus a search input when a component first mounts.
